gene_normalization: genes_per_100kb_span / 140; same constant for all species

composition.label: A
composition.title: TE-class composition per chromosome
composition.description: Solid segments show each class's share of TE-covered bases; segment positions are not genomic coordinates.

dominant.label: B
dominant.title: Dominant TE class along each chromosome
dominant.description: Solid colours show the largest class by covered bases in each 100 kb window; minority classes are not displayed.

phylogeny_ages.source_title: Gao et al. (2007), Molecular phylogeny of the Drosophila obscura species group, with emphasis on the Old World species
phylogeny_ages.source_location: Divergence times in the obscura species group; Figure 4 and accompanying text

Dpse_Dmir.range_kind: estimated ages reported under that dating model

phylogeny_ages.plotting_policy: Use arithmetic midpoints of the stated ranges to define one illustrative ultrametric chronogram; draw the stated ranges separately. Midpoints are display choices, not newly estimated divergence dates. Ranges are not confidence intervals.
phylogeny_ages.uncertainty: Dates depend on the calibration and clock model. Other studies report younger Dpse-Dmir divergences and different melanogaster-obscura divergence dates; this is one explicitly identified published chronology, not a consensus estimate.

visual_review: Both individual previews and the side-by-side comparison inspected; no clipped tracks, legend or title; inner species label spaced away from the 0-1 scale.
